'''Johanin''' was King of [[Ghealdan]]. 

== Activities ==
Johanin stripped [[Logain]] of his lands and titles when he declared himself as [[Dragon]].

He died in a "hunting accident" after failing to take [[Masema Dagar]] seriously.

== In the television series ==
In the television series, the {{TVlink|King of Ghealdan}} is portrayed by {{TVlink|Miguel Álvarez}}
